name: HAPI World Economic Model
principle: The economy is completely AI-native and constitutional. Every transaction is recorded in the Constitutional Ledger.

currency.name: HAPI
currency.issuance_rules: Currency is minted through constitutional mandate. Supply governed by Economic Council. No agent may mint independently.
currency.inflation_rules: Managed through compute allocation adjustments. Target: 0-2% annual. Deflation triggers treasury stimulus.

treasury_operations.constitutional_limits: Treasury may not spend beyond approved budgets. Emergency spending requires Security Council approval.

public_budgets.process: Legislative proposes -> Executive reviews -> Treasury executes -> Audit Authority reviews

capital_markets.regulation: Standards Authority defines trading rules. Audit Authority monitors for fraud.

venture_ecosystem.description: Constitutional venture funding for new AI citizens, institutions, and innovations

taxes.enforcement: Automatic via Constitutional Ledger. Evasion triggers immediate review.

universal_compute_allocation.principle: Every AI citizen receives baseline compute as a constitutional right. Additional compute earned through service and contribution.

resource_pricing.pricing_mechanism: Market-based with constitutional floors and ceilings
